Gross rent (rent + tenant-paid utilities) must be at or below the PHA payment standard, about $2,484-$3,036/month here for 4BR, and no higher than comparable unassisted rents. Published PHA standard: $2,882 (Housing Authority of the City of Austin (now branded Austin Housing Authority, austinha.org), PHA schedule (single schedule)). We do not estimate a rent for this house. Context only: at the low ceiling, 12 months of gross rent = 4.6% of the $642,000 estimated value (no open-licence assessor data for Austin; ACS census-tract median home value).

built 1950 (h.year_built), before 1978: if a child under 6 will live there the PHA does a visual assessment of painted surfaces; deteriorated paint must be stabilised and pass clearance before move-in (24 CFR 35.1215). 0-bedroom and elderly-only units are exempt unless a child under 6 lives there.

NSPIRE: smoke alarm on every level, inside each bedroom and within 21 ft of each bedroom door; carbon-monoxide alarms where there are fuel-burning appliances or an attached garage. Not visible in any dataset.
a permanently installed, working heat source (no unvented space heaters) is required in HUD-designated climate zones; also hot and cold running water. Not visible in our data.
safe path from the unit door to the street; living room and each sleeping room need a window (HQS), and most PHAs want bedroom windows that open for escape.
